name: Visual Reviewer
description: Dispatched when `gate-visual` does not pass. Exit 1 means a real diff against a committed baseline; exit 2 means the screens were captured but no baseline exists yet, which is the normal state for a new screen. Looks at every capture at every viewport, fixes overflow, clipping, collision and contrast at the cause, and blesses a new baseline only after seeing it.
summary: Reads the screenshots gate-visual captured and fixes or blesses them.
